description: This file defines Ethernet support functions, data structures, macros, and API for Zephyr OS networking stack, including Ethernet frame types, capabilities, VLAN support, LLDP, PTP, and DSA configurations.

methods.name: net_eth_ipv4_mcast_to_mac_addr
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 multicast address to an Ethernet MAC address.

methods.name: net_eth_ipv6_mcast_to_mac_addr
methods.description: Converts an IPv6 multicast address to an Ethernet MAC address.

methods.name: net_eth_get_hw_capabilities
methods.description: Returns hardware capabilities of the Ethernet interface.

methods.name: net_eth_vlan_enable
methods.description: Enables VLAN tagging on a network interface.

methods.name: net_eth_vlan_disable
methods.description: Disables VLAN tagging on a network interface.

methods.name: net_eth_get_vlan_tag
methods.description: Retrieves VLAN tag for a network interface.

methods.name: net_eth_get_vlan_iface
methods.description: Gets network interface associated with a VLAN tag.

methods.name: net_eth_is_vlan_enabled
methods.description: Checks if VLAN is enabled for a specific interface.

methods.name: net_eth_get_vlan_status
methods.description: Checks VLAN status for a network interface.

methods.name: net_eth_carrier_on
methods.description: Informs driver that Ethernet carrier is detected (cable connected).

methods.name: net_eth_carrier_off
methods.description: Informs driver that Ethernet carrier is lost (cable disconnected).

methods.name: net_eth_promisc_mode
methods.description: Sets promiscuous mode on or off.

methods.name: net_eth_txinjection_mode
methods.description: Sets TX-Injection mode on or off.

methods.name: net_eth_get_ptp_clock
methods.description: Returns PTP clock tied to the Ethernet interface.

methods.name: net_eth_get_ptp_clock_by_index
methods.description: Returns PTP clock by interface index.

methods.name: net_eth_get_ptp_port
methods.description: Returns PTP port number for the interface.

methods.name: net_eth_set_ptp_port
methods.description: Sets PTP port number for the interface.

methods.name: net_eth_type_is_wifi
methods.description: Checks if the interface supports Wi-Fi.
